purpose: Derive the full reduced q_s=0 cubic scalar vertex after eliminating the projectable scalar shift at cubic order, including the n=2 intrinsic-curvature carrier and the already-source-locked nonlinear alpha6 state-function contribution. Test whether shift exchange cancels the surviving soft-s vertex without selecting M_U, M_K, eta_D, eta_C or eta_S from the result.

frozen_scope.background: flat rolling/projectable branch used by the archived C9 n=2 theorem
frozen_scope.kinematics: equal-|k| elastic COM, internal s-channel spatial momentum q_s=0
frozen_scope.lapse_rule: projectable finite-k lapse perturbation is not an independent local Fourier mode; do not invent one
frozen_scope.shift_rule: solve the scalar shift constraint from the same fixed action and substitute it before classifying the reduced cubic vertex
frozen_scope.state_function_rule: use the s6fA source-locked local alpha6 contribution; do not refit s1(k)
frozen_scope.production_rule: k=0.03 Mpc^-1 production remains blocked throughout this gate

required_outputs: explicit quadratic scalar shift kernel and source on the frozen background
explicit cubic shift source terms relevant to q_s=0
algebraic shift solution through the order required for the cubic reduced action
bare carrier contribution to the q_s=0 cubic vertex
total reduced q_s=0 cubic vertex and exact cancellation residual
denominator/nondegeneracy guards for every shift solve
interpretation_rule: Both exact-zero and exact-nonzero outcomes are valid scientific PASS classifications if the fixed-action reduction is complete and audited; the gate tests which outcome holds and must not encode a preferred answer.
next_if_zero: Reassess n=2 UV viability and only then derive O(k^4) pre-EFT matching coefficients before reopening k=0.03 production.
next_if_nonzero: Do not force n=2. Compare a higher-spatial or symmetry-protected carrier that forbids/suppresses the soft-s vertex, while keeping k=0.03 production blocked.
non_claims: not a strong-field or compact-object result
